Amarnath Yatra Sees Large Pilgrim Numbers Amidst Environmental Concerns

The Amarnath Yatra has commenced with a significant number of pilgrims, with over 8,800 departing in one of the largest batches. The event is taking place in Kashmir, where local religious leaders have called for pilgrims to be treated with respect. Separately, concerns have been raised about the melting of an ice stalagmite within the cave shrine, with over 65,000 devotees having visited.
